description: This file configures and manages Axios HTTP client settings, including base URL resolution, token handling, and request/response interceptors for a React project. It provides functions to get API URLs, handle authentication tokens, and manage API request retries on token expiration.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL based on environment variables and runtime context, handling proxy paths and environment-specific fallback logic.

methods.name: getResolvedApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the final API base URL used by Axios, considering environment configuration.

methods.name: getOpenApiDocsUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the OpenAPI documentation endpoint based on the resolved API base URL.
